title: Craft hovering in S4 hangars

tellings.quote: So they actually went all the way to S4 uh and went down in the big elevators and went in and he said he saw like three or four.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on an account linked to Oscar Wolf, Bob Lazar and Dan Burisch, people who have spoken about S4, a secret site said to lie near the Area 51 military base in Nevada. Sheehan says that someone went all the way to S4, rode down in its big elevators into the hangars, and saw three or four craft there. If true, it would mean unusual craft are being kept underground at a US base.
